subject: Energy
title: Cyber Threats to the Grid
description: A quick win: understand Cyber Threats to the Grid.

hook.text: Power grids are increasingly computerized—and that makes them targets for cyberattacks.

buildup.text: SCADA systems control generators, switches, and breakers remotely—a compromised system could open breakers at will.

discovery.text: In 2015, hackers attacked Ukraine's grid—remotely opening breakers and cutting power to 230,000 customers.

twist.text: The US grid faces thousands of probing attacks daily—state-sponsored hackers map vulnerabilities for potential use.

climax.text: Air-gapping critical controls and training operators for manual override are key defenses against cyber threats.

punchline.text: A connected grid is a hackable grid—defense never stops.

quiz.question: Which country's grid was hit by a cyberattack in 2015?
